paragraphs: After Grandpa’s funeral, I went back to his bedroom to sort through the things he had left behind.
Among his belongings, I found a photograph, yellow with age. Grandpa and his coworkers stood together outside the workers’ dormitory.
I found his old diary too. With the diary and photograph packed away, I rode my motorcycle to the coal washing plant where he used to work.
The engine is quiet now. Standing outside the factory, I wonder if the dormitory in that photograph is still here.
